title: Cross-Interface Authorization for AI Computer-Use Agents
title_zh: 面向AI计算机使用智能体的跨接口授权

paragraphs.en: 提出跨接口授权协议，为计算机使用智能体枚举执行路径、验证效应并防御绕过与洗白攻击。 Computer-use agents act through graphical interfaces, command lines, APIs, scripts, and Model Context Protocol servers. A policy decision can be interface-invariant while its executable authorization is not: another route can bypass mediation, alter a security-relevant default, or commit after the authorized state has changed. We present a profile-bounded protocol for a fixed, versioned computer-use deployment. It enumerates effect-bearing routes and durable sinks, checks a route-to-sink enforcement cut, normalizes each concrete request to a canonical effect, issues a route-bound prepare ticket, and verifies the route, effect, grant, trace, profile, inventory, and authoritative state again at commit. A committed result requires an agreeing sink receipt. Under explicit assumptions, we prove profile-bounded refinement, matched-effect decision invariance, resistance to alternate-route laundering and declared cross-surface recomposition, commit-time state safety, and receipt-grounded outcomes. The reference profile registers 12 effect families, five interfaces, and 60 routes. Two structurally distinct runtime mappings produce 3,464 traces over 1,732 scenarios each: 960 commits, 2,312 denials, and 192 commits after re-preparation. An independent checker accepts every retained trace and pair and rejects 26/26 semantic regressions; coverage and normalizer suites reject 24/24 and 720/720 mutants; and 168/168 commit probes match their declared outcomes. A frozen-source audit passes 52 checks over 12 files from two independent hybrid runtimes and one public authorization substrate. Source-shaped adapter refinements commit 48/48 instrumented calls and reject 15/15 unbound cases. The resulting guarantees bind the declared profile and its effect semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 提出一种跨接口授权协议，为计算机使用智能体枚举执行路径、验证效应并防御绕过与洗白攻击。计算机使用智能体通过图形界面、命令行、API、脚本和模型上下文协议服务器执行操作。 策略决策可以是接口不变的，而其可执行的授权却不然：另一条路径可以绕过中介、更改与安全相关的默认值，或在授权状态已发生变化之后进行提交。 我们针对固定的、版本化的计算机使用部署提出一种受配置文件约束的协议。 该协议枚举承载效应的路径和持久性汇点，检查从路径到汇点的执行裁剪，将每个具体请求规范化为规范效应，签发绑定路径的准备票据，并在提交时再次验证路径、效应、授权、追踪、配置文件、清单和权威状态。 已提交的结果需要一致的汇点回执。 在显式假设下，我们证明了受配置文件约束的细化、匹配效应的决策不变性、对备选路径洗白和声明的跨表面重组的抵抗性、提交时状态安全性以及基于回执的结果。 参考配置文件注册了12个效应族、五个接口和60条路径。 两个结构上不同的运行时映射各自在1,732个场景上产生3,464条追踪：960次提交、2,312次拒绝以及192次重新准备后的提交。 一个独立的检查器接受所有保留的追踪和配对，并拒绝全部26个语义回归中的26个；覆盖率和规范化器测试套件分别拒绝24个和720个全部突变体；并且168个提交探针中的168个与其声明的结果相匹配。 一项冻结源码审计对来自两个独立混合运行时和一个公共授权基础组件的12个文件通过了52项检查。 源码形态的适配器细化提交了48个受监测调用中的48个，并拒绝15个未绑定用例中的15个。 所得到的保证与声明的配置文件及其效应语义绑定。
